context.narrative_job: Produce four net-new, avatar-led, standalone portrait Shorts from the owner-locked EP007 scripts without turning the long-form episode into crop source material.
context.production_start: The owner explicitly directed the Shorts production lane to begin after locking the exact four-script package.
context.current_constraint: No current audio or speaking presenter footage matches the locked words, so honest production begins with claim clearance, context-specific direction and labeled visual animatics.
context.viewer_before: The scripts are locked, but no production treatment yet turns them into honest, phone-native presenter films.
context.viewer_after: Each Short has an independent portrait production path, and Short 01 has a checked silent structure animatic ready for owner review before sound or paid avatar generation.

data.choice: Use four independent 1080x1920 HyperFrames projects sharing one series grammar. Keep Manav visible for roughly 60 to 75 percent of each cut, with presenter address carrying context, reasoning and conclusion and one silent graphic mechanism supporting the narrow answer. Build Short 01 first as the no-spend visual and pacing reference; preserve exact scripts and generate no paid media until the narration route and provider boundary are separately selected.
data.reason: Independent projects keep timing, captions, avatar takes, QA and release state auditable per Short. The presenter-led structure closes the discovery gap identified during script development, while a labeled static animatic allows visual work to progress without pretending the old V5 footage speaks new words.

alternatives.choice: Crop the locked R79 episode into four vertical clips.
alternatives.reason_not_selected: The owner explicitly chose net-new Shorts, and landscape crops would not provide the required cold-viewer context or context-matched presenter performance.

alternatives.choice: Reuse the accepted V5 speaking footage under the new narration.
alternatives.reason_not_selected: The mouth movement and performance belong to different words and would misrepresent synchronization.

alternatives.choice: Generate all four avatar performances before visual direction and timing are checked.
alternatives.reason_not_selected: It would spend provider credits before the scene grammar, claim boundaries and pacing reference are reviewable.

alternatives.choice: Put all four Shorts in one coupled production project.
alternatives.reason_not_selected: One coupled timeline would make per-Short timing, caption, QA and release state harder to audit and change independently.

reuse.applies_when: Producing net-new OE companion Shorts from owner-locked scripts that need independent portrait performance, timing and release state.
reuse.avoid_when: The approved job is a literal excerpt, a single multi-part film, or final narration and picture already exist as one synchronized source.

nuance.script: The spoken words remain exactly locked; visual compression cannot silently rewrite them.
nuance.claims: Exact-copy narration is cleared against bound EP007 editorial sources, but the separate Content OS release gate remains unrun.
nuance.legal: Short 03 stays a directional warning only. Fixed-fee wording does not establish legal safety, and local counsel remains the handoff.
nuance.avatar: The V5 still may identify Manav only when visibly labeled as static and not lip-synced. Final cuts require matching portrait performances.
nuance.review: A silent animatic can approve structure and visual logic; phone playback approval requires exact sound, synchronized performance and timed captions.
nuance.false_inference: A passing HyperFrames check is not owner visual approval, provider authorization, final render approval or publication approval.

data.approval_boundary: Authorizes no-spend production setup, claim clearance, four preproduction packages and a labeled silent Short 01 animatic. New provider or metered narration, four matching avatar performances, lip sync, final render, release and publication remain separately gated.
